document: Which half-marathon rows of the release never appear in the runner lookup, and which half editions are listed but never compared. analysis/build_runner_lookup.py reads this file and stops when a count differs. It states the half plan's record rule R8 (with R2 for a finish that is not a time); the half rebuild's policy file takes the rule over unchanged, and the lookup then reads it from there.
scope: every row of race_records with distance = half, from either source database

left_out.words: A half row never appears when it carries one of these pending-review flags (present in CORE) or one of these row-quality flags, or when its finish does not read as a time greater than zero. Nothing else about such a row is written anywhere: no label, no count by person.

expected.note: counts of pace-notes-marathon-half-20261113-1113, measured 2026-11-14; a row can carry two flags, so the flags add up to more than the rows

no_comparison.words: These editions are listed with their results and marked; a marked edition's results are never compared with other years or races and never enter a best, a ranking or an average. Editions are [source database, release key, year].

gun_times.rule: the release's edition_meta.timing_basis starts with "gross" (lead decision D6; the build stops unless that set equals this list)

course_suspected_short.rule: every row of the edition carries course_shortened_suspect in the person-links file (lead decision D24.10; the build stops unless the flagged editions equal this list and are flagged in full)
